n: <int> Total number of vertices in the undirected graph.
m: <int> Total number of edges in the undirected graph.
max_degree: <int> Largest number of edges incident to any single vertex in the graph.
degeneracy: <int> Smallest value d such that every subgraph contains a vertex of degree at most d.
omega: <int> Size of the largest clique known to exist in the graph.
clique_core_gap: <int> Difference between the degeneracy plus one and the maximum clique size.
edges: <list[list[int]], shape [m][2]> Each entry is a pair of vertex indices representing an undirected edge in the graph.
